intent_en: To illustrate how a tiny elite segment of the music industry disproportionately skews aggregate revenue statistics, masking the reality for the broader market.
previous_intent: To illustrate how the music industry's aggregate financial health is misleadingly inflated by the massive earnings of the top fraction of participants.
narration_support: The industry may look healthy and aggregate, but it's mostly the top 1 % inflating the average.
chart_support: A donut chart visualizing the 'TOP 1%' of the music industry (indicated by a music note icon) associated with a large monetary value.
evidence_note: Narration explicitly states the top 1% is inflating the average; chart visualizes this concentration with a music icon and a large revenue figure for the top 1%.
